summary: 34956436 (46 RCTs, 4158 adults with T2DM or prediabetes, 0.6-1.5 g/day) found lower HbA1c (-0.75%) and fasting glucose (-0.89 mmol/L), smaller when berberine was used alone (-0.38%), with extreme heterogeneity and mostly unblinded Chinese trials. Credit is scoped to glycemic outcomes in T2DM/prediabetes; the overlapping 36467075 is recorded without credit per Dr. Pham's duplicate-accounting instruction. 37598753 and 36941490 (placebo-only, abstract-only) were inspected but not used. Fourth-ruling boundary applied: glycemic outcomes only; no clinical-event or weight-loss claims.

applicability.studied_population: Adults with type 2 diabetes or prediabetes, mostly in China, taking 0.6-1.5 g/day berberine for 4 weeks to 6 months, often alongside diabetes medication; not a replacement for medication.

identity.preparation: Oral berberine (most arms 0.3-0.5 g two or three times daily); eligibility also admitted Rhizoma Coptidis

population.description: 46 RCTs, 4158 adults with type 2 diabetes or prediabetes (2063 berberine, 2095 control), mostly Chinese; 11 trials versus placebo or no treatment, 4 versus metformin, the rest as add-on to antidiabetic agents.

study_contexts.study_design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs (single-blind and open-label allowed; n>=60; >=4 weeks) with Cochrane risk of bias and GRADE.

outcomes.name: HbA1c MD -0.75% (95% CI -1.00 to -0.51), 40 trials, I2 98%; berberine alone subgroup MD -0.38% (-0.49 to -0.27)
FPG MD -0.89 mmol/L (-1.13 to -0.64), 45 trials; berberine alone -0.58 (-0.81 to -0.35); 2hPG also reduced

limitations: Extreme heterogeneity (I2 97-98%); only 5 trials blinded participants and personnel; most trials Chinese and of uneven quality (Discussion).
Most trials used berberine as add-on to antidiabetic drugs or versus no treatment; the berberine-alone effect is smaller (HbA1c -0.38%). Not a substitute for diabetes medication.

Dr. Pham asked for duplicate-source accounting with the other berberine records (A042/A043): this review overlaps 36467075 and the INGR_BERBERINE sources and must not be counted as independent replication; 36467075 is recorded here without credit for that reason.
Rhizoma Coptidis arms are admitted by eligibility; whole-herb preparations are not equivalent to purified berberine.
